preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i] <= i for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element a[i] is between 0 and i.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i+1] for i in range(n-1))

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a single line containing n integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(0 <= int(b) <= 10**6 for b in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each element in the output array b is between 0 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(MEX({int(b) for b in return_value.split()[:i+1]}) == a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each i, the MEX of the first i+1 elements of b equals a[i].
